summary.text: Emotionless Heaven and Earth is an immortal killer move named when Paradise Earth activates it.

claims.text: With Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s help, Paradise Earth gets time to prepare. White waves of light spread from between Paradise Earth’s brows and cover Spectral Soul Demon Venerable completely. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable does not feel anything at first, then the killing intent in his blood-red pupils decreases rapidly and they reveal flickers of rationality. The silhouette of a figure shows itself on Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s stomach. The immortals hear this figure speak: “Heaven and earth is emotionless, that is correct, but humans have emotions.” The figure laughs. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s pupils fill with killing intent again, and the trace of rationality vanishes. The figure caused the killer move to fail. Fang Yuan thinks of Verdant Great Sun. Paradise Earth imparts the information of emotionless heaven and earth to Shen Shang without hesitation.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable takes out a secluded domain of heaven and earth that looks like a lantern, lifts it, and shines it on the Gu Immortals. A tsunami of endless emotions surges into their hearts. Their expressions change and they resist with difficulty. Fang Yuan activates fortitude Gu while Giant Sun Immortal Venerable instills immortal essence into familial emotion Gu. Paradise Earth activates emotionless heaven and earth instead to resolve it.
By using Immortal Gu, Paradise Earth formed many heaven path killer moves like heavenly web protection veil, emotionless heaven and earth, heavenly summary earthly norm, and others.
